# promptpad

> Launch a token from a prompt: Claude MCP connector + launchpad on Robinhood Chain and Solana. Bonding curve, locked liquidity at graduation, creator fees to you.

promptpad is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
